title: Gloria (Phinot, Missa Si bona suscepimus)
desc: Dominique Phinot, Missa Si bona suscepimus, Gloria, 1557. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
